data.one_liner: Easily and consistently show material themed picker dialogs in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of customizable material design picker dialogs and helpers for lists, numbers, dates, times, colors, and files. All helpers return a Future with the picked option(s) and use an onChange handler.
use_when: You need standard Material dialog pickers for dates, times, colors, or custom items.
You want consistent dialog styling across different types of user selections.
avoid_when: You require non-Material or fully custom Cupertino-style picker widgets.
You need inline form pickers rather than dialog-based pickers.
strengths: Supports generic types for items in pickers.
Includes a wide variety of pickers (scroll, number, radio, checkbox, color, date, time, file).
Responsive dialog scaling across orientation changes.
weaknesses: Relies on external dependencies for color and file picking.

alternatives.name: flex_color_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more advanced and comprehensive color picker than the ones bundled here.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need advanced calendar and date range picking capabilities instead of standard date pickers.

data.minimal_example:
showMaterialNumberPicker(
  context: context,
  title: 'Pick Your Age',
  maxNumber: 100,
  minNumber: 14,
  selectedNumber: age,
  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => age = value),
);
